metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Directed by Denis Villeneuve (Sicario), this is a cerebral, emotionally complex sci-fi masterpiece that shares Ex Machina's intellectual depth.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: An incredibly intense, high-stakes thriller focusing on moral ambiguity and desperation, aligning perfectly with your appreciation for Gone Girl and Sicario.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: A deeply unsettling, premium horror film that combines the dread of The Others with the emotional and psychological trauma of a broken family.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: David Fincher's claustrophobic mystery thriller keeps you guessing at every turn, mirroring the high-tension environment of Exam.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: A prestige psychological mystery with a dark, Gothic atmosphere that will captivate fans of Gone Girl and The Others.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A gritty, intense character study of an ambitious sociopath navigating the dark underbelly of LA, offering high dramatic stakes.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: A methodical and suspenseful true-crime procedural that matches the slow-burn intensity and prestige of Gone Girl.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: An elite, tense neo-western crime thriller with a ruthless antagonist that matches the gritty atmosphere of Sicario.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: This dystopian masterwork presents a gritty, high-stakes survival narrative similar to the intense tone of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: An intense, black-and-white psychological descent into madness starring Willem Dafoe and Robert Pattinson, perfect for fans of The Master.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A brilliant, high-tension dark comedy thriller that critiques societal upper classes, hitting the exact pitch of It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: A gold-standard dark comedy thriller that shifts dynamically from humor to high-stakes violence, offering rich thematic complexity.

metas.name: Get Out
metas.description: A highly acclaimed psychological horror/thriller with sharp social commentary, matching the intellectual tension of Ex Machina.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description: An intensely quiet and emotionally heavy character study exploring faith, despair, and morality, appealing to fans of The Master and Conclave.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: A brilliant, complex mystery about obsessed rival magicians, full of twists that will satisfy viewers of Gone Girl and Exam.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A masterfully crafted horror-thriller that uses silence to construct unbearable, high-stakes tension.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: An intense, psychological anime masterpiece dealing with identity and paranoia, appealing to fans of high-concept mysteries like Gone Girl.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A gritty, violent, and highly engaging sci-fi thriller about artificial intelligence and bodily control, matching the dark tech vibe of Ex Machina.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: An isolated, quiet sci-fi drama focusing on existential dread and identity, ideal for viewers who enjoyed Ex Machina.

metas.name: Identity
metas.description: An intense, atmospheric whodunit psychological thriller set in a storm-swept motel that mirrors the localized panic of Exam.

metas.name: The Orphanage
metas.description: A beautifully tragic, atmospheric Spanish horror film that perfectly captures the gothic, haunting dread of The Others.

metas.name: Barbarian
metas.description: A highly unpredictable and terrifying modern horror film that subverts expectations, matching the sheer thrill of Smile 2.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: Written and directed by Taylor Sheridan (Sicario), this cold, desolate crime mystery delivers grueling tension and emotional resonance.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description: An elegant, mind-bending Korean romantic mystery-thriller filled with complex psychological dynamics reminiscent of Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: From the director of In Bruges, this dark comedy-drama blends dry humor with deeply tragic, intense emotional stakes.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description: A deeply hypnotic Japanese psychological horror-thriller that explores existential dread and matches the slow-burn chill of The Others.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: An absolute classic of gritty, high-stakes crime cinema with a dark, uncompromising vision that laid the groundwork for modern thrillers.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: Bong Joon-ho's masterpiece is a gritty, atmospheric, and frustratingly complex procedural crime drama that matches the tone of Sicario.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: A titanic American epic exploring greed and madness. Its intense performances and sweeping scope match the prestige of The Master.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: A melancholic and thoughtful sci-fi drama about human connection with AI, serving as an emotional counterpoint to Ex Machina.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: An intense, daylight-drenched folk horror film about grief and toxic relationships that matches the psychological weight of Smile 2.

metas.name: Sunshine
metas.description: Directed by Danny Boyle (28 Days Later), this intense sci-fi thriller about a dying sun blends cosmic dread with claustrophobic tension.

metas.name: Green Room
metas.description: A brutal, high-octane survival thriller that traps a punk band against white supremacists, matching the raw adrenaline of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: The Two Popes
metas.description: A dialogue-driven prestige film focusing on ideological debates between two powerful men, ideal for fans of My Dinner with Andre and Conclave.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A mind-bending, low-budget sci-fi thriller set at a dinner party, perfect for viewers of It's What's Inside and Exam.

metas.name: Misery
metas.description: An incredibly tense chamber-piece thriller about isolation and obsession, delivering high-stakes horror with premium performances.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: A legendary, gritty mystery thriller about revenge and dark family secrets that delivers one of the most shocking twists in cinema history.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: An intense bunker-bound psychological thriller that relies on claustrophobia and paranoia, sharing DNA with Exam.

metas.name: The Devil All the Time
metas.description: A star-studded, dark, and gritty Southern Gothic crime drama featuring high emotional complexity and morally compromised characters.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: An excruciatingly tense Danish psychological thriller about societal politeness pushed to terrifying, high-stakes extremes.
